title: Republicans Promoted a False Rumor That James Talarico Was in Ohio
summary: The Democratic nominee for Senate in Texas spent nine days off the trail with what he and his campaign said was a bad case of the flu. His opponents fueled rumors, including one that spread widely before it was debunked.
